Month 0–3 (ships to all customers): deliver guided connectors + 12–15 RevOps/CS/Finance starter packs, roll out an Admin Transparency Console (workspace‑admin consent toggle, “what we collect” panel, telemetry viewer, audit logs, deletion controls) and provision a customer‑isolated sandbox — RevOps prospect gets these installed within 30 days of signature.  
Month 3–6 (paid pilots / opt‑ins): release Guidance Pro as a paid, tenant‑isolated pilot (rule‑based Smart Defaults and pattern suggestions using anonymized telemetry with explicit admin opt‑in), widen explainability surfaces and canary deployments; keep Enterprise AI Playbook gated as a limited 180‑day beta invitation for qualifying enterprise pilots.  
To preserve architectural coherence and delivery velocity we will de‑scope/postpone public marketplace authoring, broad connector expansion waves and advanced analytics dashboards until after month 6, focusing squads on guidance, telemetry, and trust UX.  
Next step: I will deliver sample Admin Transparency Console screens, a customer‑facing one‑pager (what’s included vs paid) and the RevOps pilot SOW with 30/90/180‑day milestones and success metrics within five business days for legal/CS/eng review.

rounds.response:
Decision: we double‑down on two vertical bets—RevOps and Support—while preserving all guidance/transparency commitments, and prioritize shared primitives (approvals framework, SLA management, cross‑team handoff primitives, robust error‑handling/rollback, and telemetry/provenance) that let a small set of high‑quality packs drive real tool replacement.  
Roadmap (phased): 0–6 months — finish Admin Transparency Center + anonymized telemetry pipeline, deliver core primitives and 3 flagship RevOps + 3 flagship Support installable packs (runbooks, connector adapters to Salesforce/HubSpot/Zendesk, sandboxed pilots, audit logs, rollback); 6–12 months — harden packs with enterprise features (RBAC templates, SLA enforcement, retries, reporting), run 5 design‑partner pilots and instrument outcomes; 12–18 months — scale verticalization, integrate Guidance Pro/AI Playbook for assisted customization in pilots, and prepare marketplace for a controlled post‑18‑month launch.  
Tradeoffs: to preserve velocity and quality we will push public marketplace authoring, broad connector expansion waves, and large analytics dashboard investments beyond 18 months and reallocate those resources to primitives and deep vertical packs now.  
Success targets: within 12 months demonstrate pilot accounts can retire or materially reduce 1–2 point tools (e.g., lead‑routing scripts, renewal reconciliation spreadsheets, basic ticket‑escalation bots), drive ~+25–30% faster time‑to‑value (90‑day active uplift) and ~40–50% fewer manual handoffs in pilots.  
Next step: I’ll deliver a re‑baselined quarter‑by‑quarter roadmap with squad assignments, milestones and the RevOps pilot SOW for leadership review within 72 hours.
